invariants.name: canonical-slurm-configuration
invariants.command: cd "$HOME/ECODA_paper" && source src/slurm_config.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && test "$PROJECT_ROOT" = "$HOME/ECODA_paper" && test "$HPC_SCRATCH_DIR" = "$HOME/scratch/ECODA_paper" && test "$NAS_TARGET_DIR" = "/srv/smednas515.unige.ch/carmona_smb/Projects/ECODA_paper"

invariants.name: immutable-dataset-and-lock-contract
invariants.command: cd "$HOME/ECODA_paper" && test -f datasets.json && test -f pixi.toml && test -f pixi.lock && sha256sum datasets.json pixi.toml pixi.lock >/dev/null

audit_commands.name: terminal-canonical-wrapper-set
audit_commands.command: cd "$HOME/ECODA_paper" && test -f src/2_dataset_specific_preprocessing/1_submit_hpc.sh && test -f src/3_scrnaseq_preprocessing/1_submit_hpc_array.sh && test -f src/4_cell_type_annotation/1_submit_onboarding_stage.sh && test -f src/5_run_benchmark_methods/1_submit_hpc_array.sh && test -f src/utils/bash/ecoda_run_common.sh

audit_commands.name: terminal-run-owned-manifests-status
audit_commands.command: cd "$HOME/ECODA_paper" && source src/slurm_config.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -d "$HPC_SCRATCH_DIR/_ecoda_runs" && failed=0 && found=0 && for run_root in "$HPC_SCRATCH_DIR"/_ecoda_runs/*; do [ -d "$run_root" ] || continue; found=1; [ -d "$run_root/manifests" ] || failed=1; [ -d "$run_root/status" ] || failed=1; done; test "$found" -eq 1 && test "$failed" -eq 0

audit_commands.name: terminal-emitted-scheduler-status-records
audit_commands.command: cd "$HOME/ECODA_paper" && source src/slurm_config.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && found=0 && for status in "$HPC_SCRATCH_DIR"/_ecoda_runs/*/status/*; do [ -s "$status" ] || continue; if grep -q '^SCHEDULER_ID=' "$status"; then found=1; fi; done; test "$found" -eq 1

artifact_contracts.name: stage-neutral-run-root-contract
artifact_contracts.command: cd "$HOME/ECODA_paper" && source src/slurm_config.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -d "$HPC_SCRATCH_DIR/_ecoda_runs" && failed=0 && found=0 && for run_root in "$HPC_SCRATCH_DIR"/_ecoda_runs/*; do [ -d "$run_root" ] || continue; found=1; [ -d "$run_root/manifests" ] || failed=1; [ -d "$run_root/status" ] || failed=1; done; test "$found" -eq 1 && test "$failed" -eq 0

artifact_contracts.name: stage-neutral-scheduler-status-contract
artifact_contracts.command: cd "$HOME/ECODA_paper" && source src/slurm_config.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && found=0 && for status in "$HPC_SCRATCH_DIR"/_ecoda_runs/*/status/*; do [ -s "$status" ] || continue; if grep -q '^SCHEDULER_ID=' "$status"; then found=1; fi; done; test "$found" -eq 1

artifact_contracts.name: dataset-identifiers-come-from-ground-truth
artifact_contracts.command: cd "$HOME/ECODA_paper" && source src/slurm_config.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && jq -e 'has("Bassez") and (.Bassez.columns.sample != null) and (.Bassez.columns.label != null)' datasets.json >/dev/null
